mentions.name: DFW Fractional FDE
mentions.description: A local AI-adoption consultancy for SMBs whose differentiator is in-person engagement: the consultant physically shows up at the client's office and talks directly with the team, betting that business development will become personal as AI-generated outreach and social posting decline in quality.
mentions.problem: Cold outreach and social posting have been flooded with AI-generated slop, making impersonal business development less effective; the consultancy counters with face-to-face, personal engagement.
mentions.source_excerpt: A local AI-adoption consultancy business for SMBs where the differentiator is I physically show up at your office and actually talk to your team. With the slopification of cold outreach and social posting, I think the future of business development is going to be very personal.
mentions.author: gburgett
